sentences.t: Siku ya kwanza aliogopa na hakuzungumza na mtu yeyote.
sentences.en: On the first day she was afraid and did not talk to anyone.

sentences.t: Siku ya pili msichana mmoja anayeitwa Rehema alikaa karibu naye.
sentences.en: On the second day a girl called Rehema sat next to her.

sentences.t: Walianza kuzungumza na kugundua kwamba wote wanapenda kuchora.
sentences.en: They began to talk and discovered that they both like drawing.

sentences.t: Sasa wanarudi nyumbani pamoja kila siku.
sentences.en: Now they walk home together every day.

sentences.t: Sara bado anawasiliana na rafiki zake wa Arusha kwa simu.
sentences.en: Sara still keeps in touch with her Arusha friends by phone.

sentences.t: Anasema maisha mapya si mabaya kama alivyofikiri.
sentences.en: She says the new life is not as bad as she thought.

questions.q: Familia ilihamia Dodoma kwa sababu ya kazi ya baba.
questions.en: The family moved to Dodoma because of the father's job.

questions.q: Hali ya hewa ya Dodoma ni ya aina gani?
questions.en: What kind of weather does Dodoma have?

questions.q: Nyumba mpya ni kubwa kuliko ya zamani.
questions.en: The new house is bigger than the old one.

questions.q: Sara na Rehema wanapenda kufanya nini?
questions.en: What do Sara and Rehema like doing?

questions.q: Sara bado anaongea na rafiki zake wa zamani.
questions.en: Sara still talks with her old friends.
